kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أجرنثم (form IIIq)
# أَجْرَنْثِمُ (ʔajranṯimu) /ʔad͡ʒ.ran.θi.mu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِجْرَنْثَمَ (ijranṯama)
# أَجْرَنْثِمَ (ʔajranṯima) /ʔad͡ʒ.ran.θi.ma/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِجْرَنْثَمَ (ijranṯama)
# أَجْرَنْثِمْ (ʔajranṯim) /ʔad͡ʒ.ran.θim/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِجْرَنْثَمَ (ijranṯama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
